rows.label: tlk43400046_04_msg0001
rows.name:
The Hræsvelgr Mercenaries really are
a wonderful Merc Group.

rows.label: tlk43400046_04_msg0002
rows.name:
Even Father's Wildschwein Mercenaries
operate mainly in Invidia, and only
rarely go to Avaritia.

rows.label: tlk43400046_04_msg0003
rows.name:
But the Hræsvelgr lot don't
recognize borders. They go
wherever they're needed.

rows.label: tlk43400046_04_msg0004
rows.name:
Not only that but they take on
any mission, no matter how tough
or how poorly rewarded.

rows.label: tlk43400046_04_msg0005
rows.name: All in all, they're just model mercs.

rows.label: tlk43400046_04_msg0006
rows.name:
But... they'd be even more wonderful
if they worked for free.
